fishing: WHEN: Sat Nov 21 good solunar (74/100), winds N 2-9 mph (gusts 15), air 70-76F, water ~74F. PASSES-BEACH: Spanish mackerel, jacks, blue runners, flounder, snook, small ladyfish at Boca Grande / Stump Pass / Blind Pass / Englewood Beach / Manasota; live shrimp, gold spoons. LEMON BAY: trout, redfish, snook, baby gags scattered Miserable Mile to Ainger Creek; Spanish/ladyfish/bluefish along ICW and Stump Pass. NEARSHORE: mixed when seas allow (1-2 ft). Baits: live shrimp, pilchards, soft plastics, paddletails, weedless spoons, pinfish. Sources: Fishin Franks Nov 20 (Lemon Bay trout/reds/snook/baby gags; beach Spanish/jacks/flounder/snook; Placida/Gasparilla snapper/flounder/Spanish), FL Sportsman SW / Capt. Mike recent reports.
redtide: FWC Nov 20 update: K. brevis at very low concentrations in one Charlotte County sample in SWFL. Bloom concentrations in NWFL (Bay and Gulf counties). No bloom near Englewood/Manasota. No SWFL fish kills or respiratory irritation reported. Next update Nov 24.
bacteria: Charlotte/Sarasota Healthy Beaches all Good. Manasota Key Beach GOOD (10 CFU/100mL Nov 16). Englewood Beach / Manasota Key GOOD (~10 CFU/100mL recent samples). No advisories.
fpl: Charlotte ~2 / Sarasota ~148-149 minor isolated outages; no major Englewood/Manasota impact.
